title: Kit A/B: edits vs saved
author: MrScruff (rytm-mods); elemod port: Iced-Cream
description: NO + PLAY becomes an A/B between the kit as edited and as saved. The first press keeps the edits in a stash and reloads the saved kit, under stock's popup ("KIT 1 RELOADED!"); the next puts the edits back ("EDITS RESTORED!"). Editing while the original plays ends the A/B: the next press keeps those edits instead, dropping the stashed ones, and reloads as a first press does. The same happens after a change of kit or any other reload, found by a checksum of the working kit taken after each press. A press on a kit with no edits is a plain reload and arms nothing. Repoints both single-kit reload calls and their popups' text: the key handler's NO + PLAY (0x400cd4ae, "KIT %d RELOADED!") and kit_reload_key (0x400dd5de, "KIT RELOADED!"). The stash, one 0x9e3-byte kit, comes from the firmware's heap on the first press. The restore copies it back and applies it exactly as stock's reload applies the saved kit, including kit_mark(working, 0), whose meaning is not established. Reloading every kit stays stock. Port of rytm-mods 0010-kit-ab.
